correctness.rationale: The preimage-simplex definition implies at most one doubled fiber on a star. A disjoint exhaustive partition enumerates injective maps (leaf-only, singleton-center, center-plus-leaves, and the swapped-edge exception) and maps with one double fiber (image-center singleton or image-leaf with arbitrary partial leaf injection). The idempotent census follows from fixed image points. The regularity section criterion proves that exactly the described center-containing injections to leaves fail regularity, giving the full coefficient formulas. Independent brute-force definition-level checks reproduce P and E for \(1\le m\le6\) and nonregular coefficients for \(1\le m\le5\); the general proof is symbolic, not extrapolation.

value.rationale: The branching star is the first nonpath tree family following the recent path/cycle enumeration program. The rank census determines the order and image-rank distribution of its full graph-continuous partial transformation monoid; the independent idempotent polynomial determines a key intrinsic semigroup invariant. The precise classification of nonregular maps yields all regular ranks and is a structurally meaningful obstruction, not just a constant-sized example or a general lemma restatement. The result applies for every \(m\ge3\) and has a self-contained proof.
